name: Chimerstry
summary: Creates illusions and sensory deceptions potent enough to mislead the unwary.

name: Dementation
summary: Inflicts madness, instability, and emotional derangement through insight into fractured minds.

name: Animalism
summary: Command beasts, stir the Beast in others, and master predatory instinct.

name: Auspex
summary: Sharpened senses, aura reading, and supernatural perception.

name: Celerity
summary: Impossible speed, split-second reactions, and bursts of predatory motion.
levels: One dot improves initiative and reflexive speed

name: Dominate
summary: Overpower minds through command, memory editing, and psychic rule.

name: Fortitude
summary: Inhuman resilience against injury and the worst violence of the night.
levels: Two dots harden the body further
Four dots resist what would cripple others
Five dots create monstrous staying power

name: Necromancy
summary: Summons, compels, and manipulates the dead through paths and rituals tied to the Underworld.
levels: Begins command of a primary necromantic path

name: Obfuscate
summary: Hide from mortal perception, vanish, and reshape how the world notices you.

name: Obtenebration
summary: Commands living darkness, shadow tentacles, and impossible black voids.

name: Potence
summary: Channel supernatural might through decisive, crushing force.
levels: One dot grants clear strength edge
Two dots make force difficult to contest

name: Presence
summary: Manipulate emotion, awe, terror, and devotion in social encounters.

name: Quietus
summary: The silent art of assassination, blending vitae control, poison, and killing precision.

name: Protean
summary: Shift body and senses toward the beast, the earth, and predatory transformation.

name: Serpentis
summary: Reptilian transformation, hypnotic predation, and Setite body sorcery.
levels: Unfurls the Eyes of the Serpent
Extends a serpent's tongue and senses
Sloughs skin or shape more deeply

name: Thaumaturgy
summary: Hermetic blood magic built from rituals, paths, and occult hierarchy.

name: Vicissitude
summary: Flesh-shaping and bonecraft that remake bodies into works of cruelty or utility.
levels: Remakes bodies into tools or horrors
Builds war forms and crafted monstrosities
